chapter_seo_title: Broken Horn World: The Terrifying Truth About Ji Ning's Human Race
chapter_meta_description: The leaders of the Broken Horn World learn the terrifying history of the Three Realms. Ji Ning is identified as a human—the boogeyman of their primordial nightmares.
og_description: The Nine Elders of the Broken Horn World discover a "foreign race." But their Emperor reveals a terrifying truth: this tiny being is a human, a child of the legendary Nuwa, and the master of their greatest enemy.
twitter_title: The Boogeyman of the Endless Continent is Ji Ning
twitter_description: The Broken Horn World’s rulers are terrified. They just learned that every bedtime story about the terrifying humans is true, and one of them is right outside their door.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme, universal Dao that functions in all realities born from the primordial chaos, regardless of local laws. It is the only metaphysical system that works across different worlds.
One of the pocket worlds within the chaotic Endless Continent. It is inhabited by a race of powerful, horned, scale-armored warriors ruled by a collective of 'Mother Queens'.
The fragmented, unstable landmass formed from the aftermath of an ancient, cataclysmic war that shattered the primordial chaos.
The highest known cultivation level within the Endless Continent's hierarchy, equivalent to a Daofather or True God within the Three Realms.
A legendary figure in the Three Realms, credited with creating the human race and possessing the power to instantly kill Saint Lords, making her a figure of terror to the Broken Horn World's rulers.
A specific territorial perimeter within the void surrounding the Broken Horn World, now fully activated to prevent Ji Ning's escape.
An elite squad of the Broken Horn World dispatched for high-value capture missions.
